summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MindLeaf AI storytelling app covering 20 test cases. Backend auth, user management, and payment systems working correctly. Frontend navigation, story creation UI, and user flows fully functional. Story generation working in UI but API test failed with 502 timeout.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 502 'preview environment not responding' during API test
critical_bugs.impact: Story generation API test fails, but UI shows stories exist with cover images
critical_bugs.note: Story generation appears to work in practice (UI shows generated story with cover), likely a timeout or temporary issue during testing

expected_limitations.issue: Returns 403 when non-admin tries to promote users
expected_limitations.impact: Cannot test admin promotion without existing admin user
expected_limitations.note: Expected behavior - admin promotion requires existing admin privileges
